title: Getting started with sdvmodels
text: expected points model 7-class classifier next scoring event. manifest’s ep_class_contract gives class order points class worth; expected points probability-weighted sum.
code: contract <- cfb_model_manifest$ep_class_contract contract$class_order #> [1] "TD"         "Opp_TD"     "FG"         "Opp_FG"     "Safety"     #> [6] "Opp_Safety" "No_Score" contract$point_values #> [1]  7 -7  3 -3  2 -2  0  # 1st and 10 at the opponent's 25, start of the second half, tied game play <- data.frame(   TimeSecsRem = 1800, yards_to_goal = 25, distance = 10,   down_1 = 1, down_2 = 0, down_3 = 0, down_4 = 0,   pos_score_diff_start = 0 ) probs <- predict(ep, xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(play[getinfo(ep, "feature_name")]))) round(setNames(as.vector(probs), contract$class_order), 3) #>         TD     Opp_TD         FG     Opp_FG     Safety Opp_Safety   No_Score  #>      0.574      0.088      0.298      0.035      0.002      0.001      0.003  sum(probs * contract$point_values) #> [1] 4.19562

title: Getting started with sdvmodels
text: field goal model takes distance goal line plus one-hot era. era cuts part model card, encoding comes card:
code: era <- cfb_model_cards$fg_model$era_contract era$buckets #> [1] "<=2006"    "2007-2013" "2014-2020" ">=2021"  fg <- xgb.load.raw(cfb_fg_model) kicks <- data.frame(yards_to_goal = c(5, 15, 25, 35, 45)) # a 2024 season falls in the last bucket (>= 2021) kicks[era$columns] <- as.list(c(0, 0, 0, 1))  data.frame(   yards_to_goal = kicks$yards_to_goal,   kick_distance = kicks$yards_to_goal + 17,   p_make = round(predict(fg, xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(kicks[getinfo(fg, "feature_name")]))), 3) ) #>   yards_to_goal kick_distance p_make #> 1             5            22  0.939 #> 2            15            32  0.823 #> 3            25            42  0.675 #> 4            35            52  0.495 #> 5            45            62  0.366

text: data package hosts fitted models used 'cfbfastR' package wider 'SportsDataverse' ecosystem, models versioned installed instead downloaded consumer. Ships college football expected points, win probability (without point spread), overtime reach, field goal, fourth conversion, two point conversion, expected pass, completion probability (without air yards) quarterback rating models raw 'xgboost' model vectors, together punt distance distribution, field position expected points table, model cards bundle manifest documents model's feature contract. Mirrors 'fastrmodels' package 'nflverse'.

title: sdvmodels 0.1.0
text: Initial release: college football models cfb_model_artifacts release (expected points, win probability without spread, overtime reach, field goal, fourth conversion, two point conversion, expected pass, completion probability without air yards, quarterback rating) raw xgboost vectors, plus punt distance distribution, field position expected points table, model cards bundle manifest. Bundle version 2026.10.12, models sportsdataverse-py scores date. cfb_qbr_model 2026-09-30 retrain features play--play processor serves. drops spread feature (9 features, 10), consumer builds fixed column list must take feature names booster (xgboost::getinfo(m, "feature_name")). New cfb_cp_air_yards_model, completion probability model passes known air yards, cfb_wp_ot_reach_model, probability game reaches overtime. manifest now generated bundle files data-raw/MANIFEST.R; 2026.09.09 card hashes predated card upload corrected. Hex logo: isometric battery cell whose lid shows six decision trees wired terminal (gradient boosting), drawn data-raw/hex-logo/. pkgdown site https://sdvmodels.sportsdataverse.org getting started article, citation entry (citation("sdvmodels")).
